A '''woman''' belonging to the [[Farr family]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] was the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of [[Toryn Farr/Legends|Toryn]] and [[Samoc Farr/Legends|Samoc Farr]], both members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Farrs were loyal supporters of Chandrila's [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and staunch opponents of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
